children: Anthropic reported $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion in the year-earlier period. Its operating loss narrowed, to $693 million in the six months ending June 30, compared with a loss of $2.1 billion in the same period last year.

The company reported a net loss of more than $80 billion for the first half of 2026 compared with a net loss of $13 billion in the first half of 2025. The majority of the more recent loss, about $72 billion, was due to accounting charges tied to changes in the value of convertible notes and other instruments the company issued to raise funding.
